sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*751[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '38160917' LIMIT 5
rows: The trial is planned to continue until at least 751 patients experience an adjudicated triple endpoint, at least 1254 experience an adjudicated quadruple endpoint, and the median follow-up is ≥4
